Producer review feedback on CG-0MS934XSL00453HF (raised selection feature, currently in_review): when a card raises, the selection highlight does not raise with it. Additionally the raise slider should go to a maximum of 180px with a default of 60px.

Root cause: in HandView.updateSelectionTints(), applySelectionRaise(true) runs BEFORE the tint loop, so on first selection the raise tween starts before the tint overlay exists — the overlay is created at the resting position and is not in the tween targets, so the card raises while the highlight stays behind. Hover pointerover/pointerout also destroy+recreate the overlay, which can orphan it mid-tween.

## Acceptance criteria

1. Regression tests written FIRST (TDD): animated-path first-selection overlay is included in the raise tween targets; hover repaint reuses the overlay in place; reduced-motion first-selection overlay ends at the raised position.
2. The selection highlight overlay always ends at the raised position on first selection (animated and reduced-motion).
3. GymHandPileScene raise slider: RAISE_MAX = 180, RAISE_DEFAULT = 60; reset() restores the default; Controls help text updated.
4. HandView setSelectionLift() API default remains 0 (opt-in) — backward compatible.
5. npm run build succeeds and all HandView + Gym unit tests pass.

# Run `wl doctor upgrade --confirm` in Tableau-Card-Engine

## Why

This project's worklog database is behind the installed `wl` version. Every `wl` invocation prints:

```
Worklog: database at /home/rgardler/projects/Tableau-Card-Engine/.worklog/worklog.db has schemaVersion=8 but the application expects schemaVersion=9. Required columns were repaired automatically. see 'wl doctor upgrade' to list and apply pending migrations
```

Required columns are being patched on every invocation instead of migrated, and the git hooks are stale. Discovered during the 2026-11-04 downtime-dispatcher RCA (the same finding exists across the other worklog roots).

## Pending work (from `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json`)

### Schema migrations (3)

- `20260210-add-needsProducerReview` — Add needsProducerReview INTEGER column to workitems (default 0)
- `20260923-add-audit-fingerprint` — Add nullable fingerprint column to audit_results for content-based freshness gate (WL-0MUBVH5S0008NQ9K)
- `20261015-drop-needsProducerReview` — Legacy: Drop needsProducerReview column (reverted — the flag was restored by 20261016-restore-needsProducerReview) **[UNSAFE]**

### Outdated git hooks

- pre-push, post-checkout, post-merge, post-rewrite, worklog-post-pull

## Goal

As a maintainer, I want this project's worklog schema and git hooks fully up to date, so that `wl` stops auto-patching columns on every call and so every worklog hook behaves like the current template.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json` afterwards reports `pending: []` and no hook whose `status` is not `up-to-date`.
2. `wl doctor upgrade --confirm` was executed against this project's database and applied the migrations listed above.
3. A plain `wl list --json` invocation no longer prints the `schemaVersion=8 … expects schemaVersion=9` warning.
4. **Data-safety check.** The count of items with `needsProducerReview == true` is identical before and after:
   `wl list --json | jq '[.workItems[] | select(.needsProducerReview == true)] | length'`
   Record both numbers on this item.
5. `wl doctor` reports no new findings attributable to this upgrade (any residual finding is recorded on a follow-up item, not ignored).
6. The before/after `--dry-run --json` output is recorded in a comment on this item.

## Plan

1. Capture the baseline: `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json` plus the `needsProducerReview` count → comment on this item.
2. Run `wl doctor upgrade --confirm`.
3. Re-run `--dry-run` (expect nothing pending) and re-check the `needsProducerReview` count (must be unchanged).
4. If the upgrade touched tracked files (`.githooks/`, hook templates), commit them following build → test → commit order.

## Risks & notes

- `--confirm` applies migrations **non-interactively, including UNSAFE ones**. Review the `[UNSAFE]` entries above before running. The database is the runtime source of truth (SQLite); never edit `.worklog/worklog-data.jsonl` and never run `wl import` (destructive).
- If the `needsProducerReview` count changes, STOP, restore, and raise a `bug` against ContextHub's `wl` migration set instead of continuing — the drop/re-add cycle is the suspected cause of the permanent schema-8 oscillation.

## Provenance

Created from the 2026-11-04 overnight zero-dispatch RCA. Pi session `herdr-1793778909-1527089-27004`, log `/home/rgardler/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-rgardler-projects-ContextHub--/2026-11-04T07-55-10-163Z_herdr-1793778909-1527089-27004.jsonl`.

**Unsafe migrations in this sweep:** `20261015-drop-needsProducerReview`
data.title: Run wl doctor upgrade --confirm: apply pending schema migrations and refresh outdated git hooks

# Restore the pre-push test-cache mirroring (`mirror_suite_cache`) in the canonical hook template

## Why

`wl doctor upgrade --confirm` (CG-0MW1VJRY6001FOPT) replaced this repo's committed
`.githooks/pre-push` with the canonical v3 template embedded in the installed
`wl` (`PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` in `worklog/dist/doctor/hook-upgrade.js`). The
canonical template does **not** contain this repo's `mirror_suite_cache`
function, which commit `a34048ac` (CG-0MW0SBXKW000T4C0) added so that a
full-suite run performed by `implement.py finish` **from a linked worktree**
(stored in `<worktree git dir>/test-cache`, because a worktree has no
`.worklog/`) is copied into the **main checkout's** `.worklog/cache`.

Consequences after the upgrade:

- `python3 $(skill_path test)/scripts/run_tests.py --summary --suite all` in the
  main checkout reports `missing` at the pushed commit even though the pre-push
  hook ran the full suite moments earlier.
- The audit skill's execution-dependent AC auto-verification (F3) therefore
  cannot consume the push's green run; audits re-execute the suite.
- `wl doctor upgrade` reports a hook as `outdated` whenever the committed
  `.githooks/<hook>` differs from the embedded template, so the capability
  cannot simply be re-added to this repo's committed hook without failing the
  "all hooks up-to-date" invariant (CG-0MW1VJRY6001FOPT AC1).

The skill documentation (implement skill, step 9) still describes the
mirroring as part of the dev-push gate contract.

## Goal

As a maintainer, I want the cache-mirroring behaviour delivered by the canonical
pre-push hook template, so that a full-suite run performed by the pre-push gate
from a linked worktree stays visible to the main checkout's post-push
verification and to audits, without this repository having to diverge from the
canonical template.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The capability lives in the canonical template — `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` in
   the `worklog` package source (ContextHub repo) — not as a repo-local patch.
2. After `scripts/install_pi.sh` refreshes the globally installed `wl`, running
   `wl doctor upgrade --confirm` from this repository leaves
   `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json` reporting `pending: []` and every hook
   `up-to-date` (no repository-local divergence).
3. Pushing a commit to `dev` from a linked worktree (the `implement.py finish`
   path) results in a green full-suite cache entry being visible in the **main
   checkout's** `.worklog/cache` for that exact commit, so
   `run_tests.py --summary --suite all --json` reports a green (not `missing`)
   entry.
4. A test pins the behaviour: a worktree full-suite run's cache entry appears in
   the main checkout's cache, and the copy is fail-soft (a copy failure never
   fails the push).
5. The implement skill documentation and `docs/DEVELOPER.md` describe the
   mirroring as behaviour of the canonical template.

## Notes

- Discovered while applying CG-0MW1VJRY6001FOPT; the template adopted there is
  the source of truth, so the fix belongs upstream in the template.
- Cross-repo: the change lands in the `worklog` package (ContextHub) and is
  consumed here after `install_pi.sh`.
data.title: Restore pre-push test-cache mirroring (mirror_suite_cache) in the canonical wl hook template

# Bind the canonical pre-push full-suite gate to the pushed commit (`--gate-commit`)

## Problem statement

The canonical pre-push hook template (`PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` in the
`worklog` package) runs the dev/main full-suite gate as
`run_tests.py --scope full --strict-git-env` with **no commit binding**, so
the gate's verdict describes whichever tree the hook happened to run in. The
implement skill documents the dev-push gate as being bound to the pushed
commit (`run_tests.py --gate-commit <sha> --project-root <root>`) and
SorraAgents' own committed hook implements that; the distributed template
under-delivers on the documented contract, so "the dev push succeeded" does
not currently guarantee the suite ran against the commit that landed.

## Users

- **Framework maintainers** who rely on the dev push as the integration gate:
  "As a maintainer I want a green dev push to mean the full suite ran against
  the commit that landed, not against a dirty working tree."
- **Agent producers** using `implement.py finish` (push from the linked
  worktree): "As a producer I want the gate to validate exactly the worktree
  commit I am pushing, so a stale or dirty main checkout can never produce a
  misleading verdict."
- **Auditors** consuming the per-repo test cache (audit skill F3): "As an
  auditor I want the push's green `scope: full` entry to be keyed to the
  pushed commit's state, so execution-dependent ACs are auto-verified instead
  of re-executed."
- **Repo owners adopting the template via `wl init` / `wl doctor upgrade`**:
  "As a repo owner I want the upgraded hook to keep working with the runner I
  actually have installed, and to fail with an actionable message rather than
  an argparse error."

## Acceptance Criteria

1. `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` captures the pushed `<local_sha>` for each gated
   ref (`refs/heads/dev`, `refs/heads/main`) while still reading pre-push
   stdin **once**, and invokes the resolved runner as
   `--scope full --strict-git-env --json --project-root <repo_root>
   --gate-commit <sha>`. Portable runner resolution is preserved: repo-local
   `skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` first, then
   `$HOME/.pi/agent/skills/test/scripts/run_tests.py`; neither present
   remains a hard fail (never a silent skip).
2. A push carrying **several different** dev/main commits is refused with an
   actionable message (each `ref=sha` listed, plus recovery: one commit per
   push, `TEST_SCOPE_SKIP=1` / `--no-verify` escape hatches) instead of an
   undefined verdict. Deletion pushes (all-zero sha) are not treated as a
   gated commit.
3. After a green gate, the cache mirror uses the checkout the gate **actually
   resolved** (the runner's `run_tests: gate-root` stderr provenance), not
   merely the push cwd, so the entry lands in the main checkout's
   `.worklog/cache` for the commit that was validated.
4. Behavioural tests pin the behaviour in ContextHub: the stub runner observes
   `--gate-commit <pushed sha>` and `--project-root` for a dev/main push, no
   `--gate-commit` for non-gated refs, the multi-commit refusal blocks the
   push, and the mirror copies from the gate-resolved root. The committed
   `.githooks/pre-push` byte-matches the template (`wl doctor upgrade
   --dry-run --json` reports `pending: []`, every hook `up-to-date`).
5. The dirty-checkout impact is assessed and documented **before** adoption:
   the gate refuses when no clean checkout holds the pushed commit; `.gitignore`d
   `.worklog/` churn does not make a checkout dirty, so the normal
   `implement.py finish` worktree push and a clean main-checkout push still
   resolve in place. The implement skill, `../ContextHub/docs/migrations.md`
   and `docs/DEVELOPER.md` describe the final behaviour and the refusal.
6. All related documentation is updated to reflect the changes, including code
   comments, README, and any relevant wiki or docs site entries.
7. Full project test suite must pass with the new changes.

## Constraints

- The change lands **upstream** in the `worklog` package (ContextHub
  `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` + committed `.githooks/pre-push`), not as a
  repo-local patch here — the parent item's invariant (no consolidated
  divergence from the canonical template).
- The committed `.githooks/pre-push` must **byte-match** the template, or
  `wl doctor upgrade` reports the hook `outdated` and the "all hooks
  up-to-date" invariant fails.
- The hook stays POSIX `#!/bin/sh`, no bashisms, no `jq`, no new external
  binaries; pre-push stdin is read exactly once (a second read sees EOF).
- `GATE_ROOT_PREFIX` / `GATE_SUBJECT_PREFIX` line formats in `run_tests.py`
  are a contract with the hook — parse `run_tests: gate-root <path>` verbatim
  (paths may contain spaces).
- Fail closed: a missing runner or an unverifiable commit must block the
  push, never pass it.
- Portable runner resolution must be kept — this is precisely why adopting
  SorraAgents' hook wholesale was rejected in CG-0MW1ZBKP0006U1YU.
- `--gate-commit` must be supported by the runner that receives it; see
  Preferences/Pending producer decisions (Q1).
- Sequence after the mirroring restoration (CG-0MW1ZBKP0006U1YU /
  WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP): this item edits the same gate block and depends on
  `mirror_suite_cache` existing.

## Existing state

- `../ContextHub/src/doctor/hook-upgrade.ts` → `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT` is the
  canonical v3 template (155 lines). Its full-suite gate resolves
  `test_repo_root` / `test_runner` and runs `--scope full --strict-git-env`;
  no `<local_sha>` capture, no `--gate-commit`, no `--project-root`, and the
  cache mirror (added by the parent item) has no gate-root to mirror from.
- `../ContextHub/.githooks/pre-push` is byte-compared against that template by
  `tests/doctor-hook-upgrade.test.ts`; `generateCanonicalHookContent()` is the
  same constant.
- `../SorraAgents/.githooks/pre-push` (270 lines) is the reference
  implementation of the newer contract: `need_full_suite`, `gated_ref_shas`,
  the multi-commit refusal, `--scope full --strict-git-env --json
  --project-root "$repo_root" --gate-commit "$gate_commit"`, stderr captured
  to `gate_err`, `grep '^run_tests: gate-'` echoed to the pusher, and
  `mirror_suite_cache "${gate_root:-$repo_root}"` after a green run.
- `~/.pi/agent/skills/test/scripts/run_tests.py` (and SorraAgents' repo-local
  copy) implement `--gate-commit` / `--project-root`
  (SA-0MVTRBT50005DUEH): `resolve_gate_subject()` returns the push cwd when
  `HEAD` is the pushed commit **and** the checkout is clean, else a clean
  `git worktree list` checkout holding it, else `GateSubjectError` (refuse,
  exit 2) naming the commit and the `TEST_SCOPE_SKIP=1` escape hatch;
  `run_tests: gate-subject` / `gate-root` / `gate-verdict` / `gate-refused`
  lines go to stderr.
- Cleanliness is `git status --untracked-files=all` (via
  `test_cache.is_worktree_clean`); `.worklog/` is gitignored in TCE, so
  worklog churn does not dirty a checkout.
- Tests: `../ContextHub/tests/pre-push-hook-gate.test.ts` runs the committed
  hook in a throwaway git repo with a stubbed `run_tests.py` that records
  `sys.argv[1:]` into `STUB_TEST_LOG`; TCE's
  `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts` runs the committed hook
  from a linked worktree with a stubbed runner.
- This repo (TCE) carries no `skill/` tree — skills resolve from the global
  install, so `--gate-commit` support arrives with the installed runner.

## Desired change

Propagate the newer gate block into the canonical template with the smallest
diff that satisfies the ACs: capture gated `ref=sha` pairs while reading stdin
once, refuse multi-commit pushes with an actionable message, run the gate with
`--gate-commit` + `--project-root` (keeping portable runner resolution and the
hard-fail when absent), surface the runner's `run_tests: gate-*` provenance,
and mirror the cache from the resolved `gate-root` after a green run. Then
update ContextHub's committed hook byte-for-byte, extend the behavioural
tests, and document the final behaviour (implement skill,
`../ContextHub/docs/migrations.md`, `docs/DEVELOPER.md`).

## Key Files (predicted)

- `../ContextHub/src/doctor/hook-upgrade.ts` — `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT`: gate
  block gains `gated_ref_shas`, multi-commit refusal, `--gate-commit` /
  `--project-root`, `gate_err` provenance echo, gate-root mirroring.
- `../ContextHub/.githooks/pre-push` — regenerate to byte-match the template.
- `../ContextHub/tests/pre-push-hook-gate.test.ts` — pin forwarded argv,
  non-gated refs, multi-commit refusal, gate-root mirroring.
- `../ContextHub/tests/doctor-hook-upgrade.test.ts` — up-to-date invariant
  still holds for the new template.
- `../ContextHub/docs/migrations.md` — document the pre-push behaviour change
  (commit-bound gate, refusal semantics, dirty-checkout impact).
- `../SorraAgents/skill/implement/SKILL.md` — restate the gate contract as
  delivered by the canonical template (not just SorraAgents' hook).
- `docs/DEVELOPER.md` — describe the commit-bound gate and the refusal in the
  committed-hooks section.
- `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts` (optional, TCE side) —
  assert the shipped hook forwards `--gate-commit` from a linked worktree.

## Risks and assumptions

- **Risk — older repo-local runners.** A repo pinning a `skill/test/` runner
  that predates `--gate-commit` would fail the gate on an argparse error and
  block every dev/main push. Mitigation depends on Q1 (see below).
- **Risk — dirty-checkout refusals become visible.** Previously a push from a
  dirty main checkout got a verdict about the dirty tree; now it is refused
  unless a clean checkout holds the commit. In TCE the common agent path is
  `implement.py finish` from a clean linked worktree, and `.worklog/` is
  gitignored, so the risk is limited to genuinely dirty tracked trees — which
  is the behaviour the contract wants. Documented under AC5.
- **Risk — mirror regression.** Giving `mirror_suite_cache` the push cwd while
  the gate ran elsewhere would cache the wrong state; AC3 makes the gate-root
  the mirror source and the test pins it.
- **Risk — scope creep.** Hardening the delegating wrappers (`hook_dir=`
  form) was explicitly deferred in the parent item; the runtime-plugin-style
  "extra opportunities" go to linked items, not this one.
- **Assumption:** the installed (and SorraAgents') `run_tests.py` already
  supports `--gate-commit`; this item changes only the hook template, its
  committed copy, tests and docs — not the runner.
- **Assumption:** the template change is consumed here only after
  `scripts/install_pi.sh` refreshes the global `wl`, followed by
  `wl doctor upgrade --confirm`.
- **Assumption:** the reference implementation is SorraAgents'
  `.githooks/pre-push`; the template diff is a port of its gate block, not a
  redesign.

## Related work

- **CG-0MW1ZBKP0006U1YU** (in progress) — Restore pre-push test-cache mirroring
  (`mirror_suite_cache`) in the canonical hook template; its intake split this
  documented-gap follow-up out (option (b) mirror-only). **Blocked-by** for the
  shared gate block.
- **WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP** (ContextHub, open, stage `intake_complete`) — the
  mirroring counterpart upstream; this item's AC3 extends its call site.
- **SA-0MW20Y5YI004QS3M** (SorraAgents) — implement-skill documentation of the
  gate contract (AC5 there); this item's documentation AC extends it.
- **SA-0MVTRBT50005DUEH** — the pushed-commit subject binding implemented in
  `run_tests.py` and SorraAgents' hook (design precedent).
- **WL-0MVHP5S01006GDDV** (completed) — the dev/main full-suite gate itself in
  the canonical template.
- **CG-0MW0SC8O7009RYJ6** (completed) — full-suite gate rollout to
  `tce-main-street`; **CG-0MUFIBB2X008A136** (completed) — push-cwd stale-main
  problem the commit binding solves.
- Related files: `../ContextHub/tests/pre-push-hook-gate.test.ts`,
  `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts`,
  `~/.pi/agent/skills/test/scripts/run_tests.py`
  (`resolve_gate_subject`, `is_worktree_clean`).

## Duplicate-work check

Searched the TCE and ContextHub stores for `gate-commit`, `pre-push hook
template`, `pre-push hook`, `full-suite gate`. No completed or open item
already satisfies this item's ACs: the mirroring counterpart
(WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP) explicitly leaves `--gate-commit` out, and the parent
item captures this gap as a follow-up rather than delivering it. No rewrite
or close needed.

## Preferences / pending producer decisions

The three decisions below could change the ACs or the implementation shape;
each is recorded with the agent's recommended option and the working
assumption used by this brief. Confirmation (or override) is requested from
the producer.

### Q1 — Runner compatibility when the forwarded flag is unsupported

The template ships to arbitrary repos that may pin a repo-local
`skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` predating `--gate-commit`.

- (a) **Unconditional** — always pass `--gate-commit` (parity with
  SorraAgents' hook). An older repo-local runner fails the gate with an
  argparse error; the fix is to upgrade that repo's runner.
- (b) **Capability probe + fallback** — detect support (e.g.
  `python3 "$runner" --help | grep -q -- --gate-commit`) and fall back to the
  unbound invocation with a loud `pre-push: warning:` when absent.
- (c) **Unconditional + explicit pre-check** — pass `--gate-commit`, but
  pre-check support and refuse with a named message ("repo-local runner
  predates `--gate-commit`; upgrade it or set `TEST_SCOPE_SKIP=1`") instead of
  surfacing an argparse error.

**Recommended:** (c) — keeps the gate fail-closed and the contract
unweakened while replacing an opaque argparse failure with an actionable
message.

Working assumption until the producer answers: (c).

### Q2 — Upstream tracking of the cross-repo edits

- (a) **New `WL-` item** in `../ContextHub/.worklog` for the template + hook +
  tests + `docs/migrations.md`, plus a `SA-` note for the implement-skill doc
  (reusing SA-0MW20Y5YI004QS3M where it already covers the contract), while
  this `CG-` item carries the TCE `docs/DEVELOPER.md` update.
- (b) **Record everything on this `CG-` item** only.
- (c) **Extend WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP** (the mirroring item) to carry both
  template changes in one pass.

**Recommended:** (a) — matches the parent item's established pattern and
keeps each store's release notes accurate; (c) would make one item cover two
independently verifiable capabilities.

Working assumption until the producer answers: (a).

### Q3 — Sequencing relative to the mirroring restoration

- (a) **Blocked-by** CG-0MW1ZBKP0006U1YU / WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP — land
  mirroring first, then change its call site once to the gate-resolved root.
- (b) **Land together** with the mirroring change in a single template edit
  (one rebuild, one byte-match, one test pass) — explicitly superseding the
  mirroring item if the producer prefers.
- (c) **Land independently now** — the mirror keeps using the push cwd until
  the mirroring item lands (transiently caches the wrong state for pushes
  resolved in another checkout).

**Recommended:** (a) — smallest verifiable steps, no transient wrong-cache
window, and it matches the parent item's decision to split the gap out as a
follow-up.

Working assumption until the producer answers: (a) (`Blocked-by:
WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP`).

## Appendix: Clarifying questions & answers

- **Q1 (process/compatibility).** "How should the template behave when the
  resolved runner does not support `--gate-commit` — unconditional
  pass-through, capability probe + unbound fallback, or unconditional plus an
  explicit pre-check with a named message?"
  — **OPEN QUESTION**, pending producer review. Agent recommendation: (c)
  unconditional + explicit pre-check. Source: recorded in
  `wl comment add CG-0MW2151GL003SV5E` (producer-review handoff); no
  operator was available for this auto-dispatched session. Research: inspected
  `../SorraAgents/.githooks/pre-push` (passes the flag unconditionally),
  `~/.pi/agent/skills/test/scripts/run_tests.py` (`--gate-commit` supported),
  and CG-0MW1ZBKP0006U1YU's intake finding that repos may have no repo-local
  runner or may ship an older one.
- **Q2 (traceability).** "Where should the upstream `worklog` package edits
  be tracked — a new ContextHub `WL-` item, this `CG-` item only, or by
  extending the mirroring item WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP?"
  — **OPEN QUESTION**, pending producer review. Agent recommendation: (a) new
  `WL-` item plus a SorraAgents doc note. Source: as above. Research:
  `wl show WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP --json` (open, `intake_complete`, mirroring
  only); CG-0MW1ZBKP0006U1YU Q2 resolved the same pattern as (a).
- **Q3 (sequencing).** "Should this change be recorded as blocked-by the
  mirroring restoration, land in the same edit, or land independently?"
  — **OPEN QUESTION**, pending producer review. Agent recommendation: (a)
  blocked-by. Source: as above. Research: both items edit the same
  `mirror_suite_cache` call site in `PRE_PUSH_HOOK_CONTENT`; the parent item is
  still in progress and WL-0MW20XXWE00466FP is `intake_complete`, so the
  function does not yet exist upstream.

# Completed — pushed to dev (commit 5a16c2fb)

## What changed

- `.githooks/pre-push`, `post-checkout`, `post-merge`, `post-rewrite`, `worklog-post-pull` replaced with the **canonical v3 template** embedded in the installed `wl` (byte-identical, so `wl doctor upgrade` reports every hook `up-to-date`).
- Two source-form assertions in the hook tests relaxed to assert the *behaviour* rather than one spelling, because the canonical template differs cosmetically but not behaviourally:
  - `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold-hook-gate.test.ts` — the wrapper must resolve `worklog-post-pull` from its own directory; `/dirname (?:-- )?"\$0"/` accepts both the canonical `dirname "$0"` and the previous `dirname -- "$0"`.
  - `tests/scripts/game-repo-scaffold.test.ts` — the gate must resolve its runner `<repo>/skill/test/scripts/run_tests.py` local-then-global; the pattern is now variable-name agnostic (`$repo_root` → `$test_repo_root` in the canonical template).

## Gate results

- Build: `npm run build` green (incl. the `check:ui-node-surface` prebuild gate).
- Finish changed-scope gate: green.
- Dev-push pre-push full suite: **PASS** (`all: PASS [full scope] [type full]`, 207 s) at the pushed commit 5a16c2fb.
- Post-push main-checkout full suite (regenerated because the canonical hook no longer mirrors the worktree cache — see CG-0MW1ZBKP0006U1YU): **239 test files / 3758 tests + 41 browser files passed**, cached at 5a16c2fb.

## Post-AC verification in the main checkout (now at 5a16c2fb)

- **AC1** — `wl doctor upgrade --dry-run --json`: `pending: []`, every hook `up-to-date` (outdatedCount 0, upToDateCount 5).
- **AC2** — `--confirm` applied 4 migrations (`20260210-add-needsProducerReview`, `20260923-add-audit-fingerprint`, `20261015-drop-needsProducerReview`, plus the extra safe `20261102-drop-dependency-edge-target-fk`); DB backup `.worklog/backups/worklog.db.2026-11-04T102538`.
- **AC3** — plain `wl list --json`: empty stderr (no `schemaVersion=8 … expects 9` warning); stored `schemaVersion` is now 9.
- **AC4** — `needsProducerReview == true` count: **38 before, 38 after** (unchanged).

- **State loss in the canonical template:** it drops this repo's `mirror_suite_cache` (and the runner's `--json` flag), so a pre-push full-suite run made from a linked worktree is no longer mirrored into the main checkout's `.worklog/cache`; post-push `run_tests.py --summary` therefore reported `missing` and the suite was re-run in the main checkout for the evidence above.
